changelog:
Initial release of Creator Financial Health Auditor.

- Aggregates revenue across Stripe, PayPal, affiliate, sponsorships, and course sales to provide accurate financial reporting.
- Calculates true profitability per content piece, factoring in platform fees, time cost, and other expenses.
- Identifies unprofitable audience segments and content verticals, with actionable recommendations to optimize or sunset.
- Forecasts cash flow and runway, sending automated alerts for potential shortfalls.
- Ranks content verticals by margin and recommends high-ROI areas to prioritize.
- Supports automated financial health reports, including weekly Slack summaries.
display_name: Analyze Creator Financial Health with Automated Reporting
summary: Analyze creator revenue streams (Stripe, PayPal, affiliate, sponsorships) to calculate true profitability per content piece, identify unprofitable segments, forecast cash flow gaps, and recommend high-margin content verticals. Use when the user needs revenue analysis, margin reporting, content ROI, or cash flow forecasting.
